中文功能定位: 独立诊断或修复已有 Sysblock/CCaller 的具体故障；编辑和交付引用框图/信号规则，按所需终端阶段验收。
英文功能定位: Independently diagnose or repair failures in existing Sysplorer Sysblock diagrams, including components, ports, connections, parameters, sample times, simulation, code generation, generated solvers, and CCaller source/configuration. Use for a concrete failure or abnormal result; do not use for new diagram construction, routine layout, controller tuning, or pure API lookup.
